desc: Derive expansion and power-sum fact: T(c) = Σ_{x=1}^{p-1} x^c ≡ -1 (mod p) if (p-1)|c (including c=0), else 0 for c≥1

Characterize surviving walks: global sign (-1)^K from all K zero edges; for odd p at most one zero edge used exactly p-1 times plus one fixed step; non-loop zero edges contribute only when p=3 (walk u→v→u→v)
Final formula: S = (-1)^K·(A^p + C1 + C2 + [p=3]C3) mod p; p=2 case = B² with zeros→1; verified on samples 1–2 by hand and sample 3 via trace invariant tr(A^p)≡tr(A)
Implement the solution in Python: numpy int64 split (2^15) modular matmul, binary exponentiation for A^p, corrections C1/C2/C3, sign (-1)^K, p=2 special case, fast I/O and output formatting
Review the implementation for edge cases (N=1, K=0, p=2, p=3, p near 1e9, int64 overflow bounds) and confirm output matches required format before finalizing
